CALL TO ORDER REGULAR MEETING

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS & PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and give
that card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting.
Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the
end of the meeting. If a member of the public submitted public comments on a Consent
Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for separate
discussion and to hear the public comment on the Consent Calendar item at that time.
Public comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us
before 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting. Public comments for items not listed on the
agenda will be heard at this time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council
is prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer
the matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

minutes_text:
ARTESIA  CITY COUNCIL  AND THE SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY  REGULAR  MEETING MINUTES

  MONDAY,  DECEMBER  11, 2023,  7:00  P.M.
  COUNCIL  CHAMBERS,  18747  CLARKDALE  AVENUE,  ARTESIA,  CALIFORNIA

CALL  TO ORDER
Mayor  Manalo  called  the meeting  to order at 7:39 p.m.

ROLL  CALL
Present: Mayor Manalo, Mayor Pro Tem Lima, Councilmembers  Taj, Trevino, and Ramoso
Staff Present:  City Manager  Schindler,  Deputy  City Manager  Burke,  City Clerk Alderete,  City
Attorney  Nguyen, Finance  Manager  Murguia,  Community  Development  Director  Dor,  Parks
and Recreation  Manager  Guerra, Special Projects Manager  Lee, Management  Analysts
Tafoya-Nacionales,  Laquian, Weichbrodt,  Dean, Fajardo, and  Administrative  Secretary  Nieto-
Linares

INVOCATION
Victor Manalo  delivered  the invocation.

PLEDGE  OF ALLEGIANCE
Miss Artesia and Miss Artesia  Teens  led the pledge  of allegiance.

PUBLIC  COMMENTS
Public  comments  could  be  provided,  in  person  or  submitted  by  email  to
publigcomments@ciJygf3riesi3.i,is  by 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting. We received
written comments  in advance  of the meeting from Jonathan  Hawes, which were provided  to
the Council and public in the lobby agenda packet. No public comments  were made in-person.

COUNCILMEMBER  COMMENTS
There were no comments.

REORGANIZATION  PROGRAM
1. SELECTION  OF  MAYOR
  Mayor  Manalo  opened  the nominations  for Mayor.  Councilmember  Trevino  nominated
  Councilmember  Lima and Council affirmed  the nomination  with a unanimous  vote.

2.  SELECTION  OF MAYOR PRO TEM
  Mayor Lima opened the nominations  for Mayor Pro Tem.  Councilmember  Manalo nominated
  Councilmember  Taj and Council affirmed the nomination  with a unanimous  vote.

3.  INCOMING  MAYOR'S  COMMENTS
  Mayor Lima provided comments.

COUNCILMEMBER  COMMENTS
Mayor  Pro Tem  Taj,  Councilmembers  Manalo,  Ramoso,  and  Trevino,  provided
comments

ADJOURNMENT
The meeting  was adjourned  at 8:05 p.m. to the Adjourned  Regular City Council Meeting and
Successor  Agency meeting  on December  "18, 2023, at 7:00p.m.  in the City Council Chambers
located at I 8747 Clarkdale  Ave. Artesia, CA 90701.

Jennifer  Alderete,  City Clerk
